paragraphs.text: A supervoid is a singularity with unusual properties - different from a true black hole .

Supervoids are ringed in a photon collar, the body of the star that they were born from, stretched and warped by tremendous gravitational forces. A photon collar is dim when compared to a main sequence star but still bright enough to emit enough light, heat, and radiation to sustain life in a system. Collapse into a supervoid — engineered by Monoists or as a natural phenomenon — forestalls nova death. One thousand supervoids have been created or discovered by the Monoist faith.

The Monasteriat is a congress of monks who administer Monoist doctrine from the faith's capital at the Lip of Susur, the photon collar that rings Point Prime , the first and most holy supervoid of the Monoist faith. The faith holds that the Immortal Faller can be observed approaching the center of every supervoid, known as the Zero Point , beyond which INEVITA , the promised future, awaits. The creation of more supervoids accelerates their journey to the Next Eternity.

The Sothera system is a pivotal front in the Entropy War with the Celestial Palatinate . Sothera was once a star that was going to become a supernova. The Monoists caused it to instead collapse in on itself into a supervoid, by bringing it sekhar - a bead that causes singularity induction. The Monoists wish to continue to collapse the black hole further to grow it while the Celestial Palatinate fights them to instead re-ignite the star via the use of colossal star-reviving weapons called horizon javelins .
